    "# ============================================ ENVIRONMENT &amp; DEVICE (CP01 evidence)\n",

    "import importlib.util, importlib.metadata, time\n",

    "\n",

    "def pkg_ver(name):\n",

    "    try: return importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",

    "    except Exception: return None\n",

    "\n",

    "import torch\n",

    "assert not [torch.cuda.is](http://torch.cuda.is)_available(), \"CUDA visible on an AMD-only study host — stop.\"\n",

    "ENV = {\"timestamp\": TS, \"host_platform\": platform.platform(), \"python\": sys.version.split()[0],\n",

    "       \"machine\": platform.machine(), \"cpu_count_logical\": os.cpu_count(),\n",

    "       \"torch\": torch.__version__, \"torch_cuda_available\": bool([torch.cuda.is](http://torch.cuda.is)_available()),\n",

    "       \"torch_directml\": pkg_ver(\"torch-directml\"), \"torchvision\": pkg_ver(\"torchvision\"),\n",

    "       \"timm\": pkg_ver(\"timm\"), \"thop\": pkg_ver(\"thop\"), \"pandas\": pd.__version__, \"sklearn\": pkg_ver(\"scikit-learn\")}\n",

    "try: ENV[\"ram_gb_total\"] = round(os.sysconf(\"SC_PAGE_SIZE\")  *os.sysconf(\"SC_PHYS_PAGES\") / 2**30, 2)\n",

    "except Exception: ENV[\"ram_gb_total\"] = None\n",

    "\n",

    "DIRECTML_ERROR = None\n",

    "try:\n",

    "    import torch_directml\n",

    "    DEVICE = torch_directml.device(); BACKEND = \"directml\"\n",

    "except Exception as e:\n",

    "    DIRECTML_ERROR = repr(e); DEVICE = torch.device(\"cpu\"); BACKEND = \"cpu-fallback (DirectML unavailable on this host)\"\n",

    "ENV[\"device_resolved\"] = str(DEVICE); ENV[\"backend\"] = BACKEND; ENV[\"directml_import_error\"] = DIRECTML_ERROR\n",

    "ENV[\"num_workers\"] = CFG.NUM_WORKERS; ENV[\"dtype\"] = CFG.DTYPE\n",

    "\n",

    "torch.manual_seed(CFG.STAT_SEED)\n",

    "def matmul_smoke(device, n=512, reps=30, warmup=5):\n",

    "    a = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float32); b = torch.randn(n, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)\n",

    "    for _ in range(warmup): c = a @ b\n",

    "    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n",

    "    for _ in range(reps): c = a @ b\n",

    "    return float(c.mean().item()), (time.perf_counter() - t0) / reps\n",

    "smoke_val, smoke_dt = matmul_smoke(DEVICE)\n",

    "TIMING_LABEL = \"APPROXIMATE (no DirectML synchronization contract)\" if BACKEND.startswith(\"cpu\") else \"APPROXIMATE (DirectML async)\"\n",

    "ENV[\"matmul_smoke\"] = {\"device\": str(DEVICE), \"mean\": round(smoke_val, 5), \"ms_per_matmul\": round(smoke_dt * 1e3, 3),\n",

    "                       \"timing_label\": TIMING_LABEL, \"passed\": bool(abs(smoke_val) &lt; 1.0)}\n",

    "print(\"=== ENVIRONMENT CARD (CP01) ===\"); display(pd.DataFrame(list(ENV.items()), columns=[\"key\", \"value\"]))\n",

    "print(f\"DEVICE PRIORITY DirectML &gt; CPU -&gt; {BACKEND} | smoke: {'PASS' if ENV['matmul_smoke']['passed'] else 'FAIL'} \"\n",

    "      f\"({smoke_dt*1e3:.2f} ms/matmul, {TIMING_LABEL})\")\n",

    "if BACKEND.startswith(\"cpu\"):\n",

    "    print(\"NOTE: K5/K6 (DirectML) remain PENDING_TARGET — identical code executes them on the Windows target.\")"

   ]

    "# ============================================================ P0 EDGEMIL-CA + CP08 UNIT TESTS\n",

    "import torch.nn as nn\n",

    "\n",

    "class ConvBNAct(nn.Sequential):\n",

    "    def **init**(self, cin, cout, k=3, s=1, g=1, act=True):\n",

    "        layers = [nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, k, s, k // 2, groups=g, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(cout)]\n",

    "        layers.append(nn.Hardswish(inplace=True) if act else nn.Identity())\n",

    "        super().__init__(*layers)\n",

    "\n",

    "class FixedSobel(nn.Module):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Fixed (non-trainable) grouped depthwise Sobel-x/y magnitude prior.\"\"\"\n",

    "    def **init**(self, c):\n",

    "        super().__init__()\n",

    "        kx = torch.tensor([[-1., 0., 1.], [-2., 0., 2.], [-1., 0., 1.]]) / 4.0\n",

    "        ky = kx.t().contiguous()\n",

    "        self.register_buffer(\"weight\", torch.stack([kx, ky]).view(2, 1, 3, 3).repeat(c, 1, 1, 1)); self.c = c\n",

    "    def forward(self, x):\n",

    "        g = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, self.weight, padding=1, groups=self.c)\n",

    "        return torch.sqrt(g[:, 0::2]  **2 + g[:, 1::2]**  2 + 1e-6)\n",

    "\n",

    "class EdgeContextAttention(nn.Module):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Research-use attention block per mission spec; NOT claimed novel in code.\n",

    "    Ablations: use_sobel -&gt; A1; use_multiscale -&gt; A2; use_eca -&gt; A3.\"\"\"\n",

    "    def **init**(self, c, use_sobel=True, use_multiscale=True, use_eca=True):\n",

    "        super().__init__()\n",

    "        self.use_sobel, self.use_multiscale, self.use_eca = use_sobel, use_multiscale, use_eca\n",

    "        self.sobel = FixedSobel(c) if use_sobel else None\n",

    "        self.edge_proj = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 1, bias=True)\n",

    "        self.dw_a = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, 1, 1, groups=c, bias=False)\n",

    "        self.dw_b = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, 1, 2, dilation=2, groups=c, bias=False) if use_multiscale else None\n",

    "        self.u_proj = nn.Conv2d(2 * c if use_multiscale else c, c, 1, bias=True)\n",

    "        self.gate_r = nn.Conv2d(3 * c, c, 1, bias=True)\n",

    "        self.eca = nn.Conv1d(1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False) if use_eca else None\n",

    "        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))\n",

    "    def forward(self, x):\n",

    "        e = self.edge_proj(self.sobel(x) if self.use_sobel else x)\n",

    "        u_in = [torch.cat](http://torch.cat)([self.dw_a(x), self.dw_b(x)], dim=1) if self.use_multiscale else self.dw_a(x)\n",

    "        u = self.u_proj(u_in)\n",

    "        r = torch.sigmoid(self.gate_r([torch.cat](http://torch.cat)([x, e, u], dim=1)))\n",

    "        f = r  *e + (1 - r)*  u\n",

    "        if self.use_eca:\n",

    "            g = torch.sigmoid(self.eca(f.mean(dim=(2, 3)).unsqueeze(1))).transpose(1, 2).unsqueeze(-1)  # (B,C,1,1)\n",

    "        else:\n",

    "            g = 1.0\n",

    "        self._dbg = (r.detach(), (g.detach() if [torch.is](http://torch.is)_tensor(g) else None))\n",

    "        return x + self.gamma  *(g*  f)\n",

    "\n",

    "class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):\n",

    "    def **init**(self, cin, cout, s, e, attn_cfg=None):\n",

    "        super().__init__()\n",

    "        mid = cin * e\n",

    "        self.use_res = (s == 1 and cin == cout)\n",

    "        layers = [ConvBNAct(cin, mid, 1, 1)] if e != 1 else []\n",

    "        layers += [ConvBNAct(mid, mid, 3, s, g=mid), ConvBNAct(mid, cout, 1, 1, act=False)]\n",

    "        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)\n",

    "        self.attn = EdgeContextAttention(cout, **attn_cfg) if attn_cfg is not None else None\n",

    "    def forward(self, x):\n",

    "        y = self.conv(x)\n",

    "        if self.use_res: y = y + x\n",

    "        if self.attn is not None: y = self.attn(y)\n",

    "        return y\n",

    "\n",

    "\n",

    "    \"\"\"Proposed compact CNN (research-use classifier). ablation in {'A4' full,'A0' no-attn,'A1' no-sobel,'A2' no-multiscale,'A3' no-eca}.\"\"\"\n",

    "# ============================================================ K-GATE STATUS TABLE (v2, includes P0 + additions)\n",

    "def kg(row_key, label):\n",

    "    c = *c(row*key)\n",

    "    built = bool(c and c[\"built\"]); p0 = (row_key == \"P0\")\n",

    "    g = {\"model\": f\"{row_key} {label}\"}\n",

    "    g[\"K1_paper_impl\"] = (\"N/A — in-house proposed implementation (spec-driven); literature mapping at paper loop\" if p0 else\n",

    "                          (\"STATIC-PASS (reputable route) — URL/commit freeze on target\" if built else \"PENDING_TARGET\"))\n",

    "    g[\"K2_licence_weights\"] = (\"N/A — scratch model, own weights\" if p0 else \"PENDING_TARGET (record from official source)\")\n",

    "    g[\"K3_no_cuda_custom_ops\"] = c[\"cuda_custom_kernels\"] if built else \"PENDING_TARGET\"\n",

    "    g[\"K4_params_macs_stratum\"] = (f\"PASS-CPU {c['params']:,}p | {c['thop_macs']:,}M | {c['stratum']}\" if (built and c[\"thop_macs\"]) else\n",

    "                                   (f\"PARTIAL-CPU {c['params']:,}p\" if built else \"PENDING_TARGET\"))\n",

    "    g[\"K5_dml_fwd\"] = \"PENDING_TARGET\"\n",

    "    g[\"K6_dml_bwd_opt\"] = (\"PENDING_TARGET (CPU equivalent PASS)\" if built else \"PENDING_TARGET\")\n",

    "    g[\"K7_serial\"] = c[\"serial_roundtrip\"] if built else \"PENDING_TARGET\"\n",

    "    g[\"K8_fair_protocol\"] = \"PREDECLARED — locks at CP09\"\n",

    "    g[\"K9_stability_purpose\"] = \"PASS-PREDECLARED\"\n",

    "    if p0: g[\"K9_stability_purpose\"] = \"PASS + CP08 battery PASS\"\n",

    "    return g\n",

    "\n",

    "# ============================================ EMIT FUNCTIONS / ARTIFACTS / LEDGER (v2)\n",

    "import matplotlib\n",

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

    "\n",

    "ARTIFACTS, CHECKPOINTS = [], []\n",

    "\n",

    "def sha256_file(p):\n",

    "    h = hashlib.sha256()\n",

    "    with open(p, \"rb\") as f:\n",

    "        for chunk in iter(lambda: [f.read](http://f.read)(1 &lt;&lt; 20), b\"\"): h.update(chunk)\n",

    "    return h.hexdigest()\n",

    "\n",

    "def register_artifact(path, purpose, status=\"VALID\", surface=\"primary\"):\n",

    "    p = Path(path)\n",

    "    ARTIFACTS.append({\"path\": str(p.relative_to(WORKSPACE)), \"purpose\": purpose, \"status\": status,\n",

    "                      \"surface\": surface, \"bytes\": p.stat().st_size if [p.is](http://p.is)_file() else 0,\n",

    "                      \"sha256\": sha256_file(p) if [p.is](http://p.is)_file() else None, \"registered\": TS})\n",

    "    return ARTIFACTS[-1]\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_status(msg): print(f\"[STATUS {[datetime.datetime.now](http://datetime.datetime.now)().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}\")\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_checkpoint(cp, name, status, detail):\n",

    "    CHECKPOINTS.append({\"cp\": cp, \"name\": name, \"status\": status, \"detail\": detail, \"time\": TS})\n",

    "    print(f\"[{cp}] {status:&lt;26} {name} — {detail}\")\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_table(df, name, caption=\"\", subdir=\"\", surface=\"primary\", show=True):\n",

    "    if show:\n",

    "        print(f\"--- TABLE {name} ---\")\n",

    "        for ln in caption.splitlines():\n",

    "            if ln: print(\"   \" + ln)\n",

    "        display(df)\n",

    "    p = RESULTS / \"tables\" / subdir / f\"{name}.csv\"; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",

    "    [df.to](http://df.to)_csv(p, index=False); register_artifact(p, f\"table:{name}\", surface=surface)\n",

    "    return p\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_figure(fig, name, caption=\"\", journal=False, subdir=\"\", surface=\"primary\", outdir=None, show=True):\n",

    "    if show:\n",

    "        print(f\"--- FIGURE {name} ---\")\n",

    "        for ln in caption.splitlines():\n",

    "            if ln: print(\"   \" + ln)\n",

    "        display(fig)\n",

    "    base = Path(outdir) if outdir else RESULTS / (\"figures/journal_main\" if journal else \"figures/individual\") / subdir\n",

    "    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",

    "    saved = {}\n",

    "    for fmt, kw in [(\"png\", dict(dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")),\n",

    "                    (\"svg\", dict(bbox_inches=\"tight\")),\n",

    "                    (\"tiff\", dict(dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\"))]:\n",

    "        p = base / f\"{name}.{fmt}\"\n",

    "        fig.savefig(p, format=fmt, **kw); saved[fmt] = p\n",

    "        register_artifact(p, f\"figure:{name}:{fmt}\", surface=surface)\n",

    "    plt.close(fig)\n",

    "    return saved\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_text(path, text, purpose, surface=\"primary\"):\n",

    "    p = Path(path); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",

    "    p.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\"); register_artifact(p, purpose, surface=surface); return p\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_json(path, obj, purpose, surface=\"primary\", register=True):\n",

    "    p = Path(path); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",

    "    with open(p, \"w\") as f: json.dump(obj, f, indent=1, default=str)\n",

    "    if register: register_artifact(p, purpose, surface=surface)\n",

    "    return p\n",

    "\n",

    "def emit_metric_panel(name, payload, surface=\"primary\"):\n",

    "    print(f\"--- METRIC PANEL {name} ({surface}) ---\")\n",

    "    display(pd.DataFrame(payload)) if isinstance(payload, list) else display(pd.DataFrame(list(payload.items()), columns=[\"metric\", \"value\"]))\n",

    "\n",

    "def dedupe_manifest():\n",

    "    seen = {}\n",

    "    for a in ARTIFACTS: seen[a[\"path\"]] = a          # keep LAST registration (fixes v1-F1 stale/duplicate)\n",

    "    ARTIFACTS[:] = list(seen.values())\n",

    "\n",

    "def assert_selftest_isolation():\n",

    "    \"\"\"Guard: selftest artifacts must never enter primary benchmark surfaces.\"\"\"\n",

    "    for a in ARTIFACTS:\n",

    "        if a[\"surface\"] == \"selftest\":\n",

    "            if \"/selftest/\" not in a[\"path\"].replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\"):\n",

    "                guard(False, \"selftest artifact leaked outside selftest namespace: \" + a[\"path\"])\n",

    "\n",

    "print(\"infra v2 ready: emit_status/emit_checkpoint/emit_table/emit_figure(png300+svg+tiff)/emit_text/emit_metric_panel/register_artifact/dedupe_manifest/assert_selftest_isolation\")"

    "# ============================================================ TRAINING PIPELINE (real, dataset-gated)\n",

    "from [torch.utils.data](http://torch.utils.data) import DataLoader, TensorDataset\n",

    "\n",

    "class DatasetGate(RuntimeError): pass\n",

    "\n",

    "def build_manifest_and_loaders(batch_size=None):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Phase-1 gate. BLOCKED until B1 resolved on target. Unknown-class folder =&gt; hard error; rejects corrupt (no placeholders).\"\"\"\n",

    "    root = next((Path(c) for c in DATASET_CANDIDATES if Path(c).exists()), None)\n",

    "    if root is None:\n",

    "        raise DatasetGate(\"B1: dataset root not mounted. Expected e.g. \" + DATASET_CANDIDATES[0] +\n",

    "                          \". Mount Kaggle amanrajbose/millitary-vechiles, rerun Phase 1 (manifest+SHA-256+dedup), then training unlocks.\")\n",

    "    raise NotImplementedError(\"manifest builder runs in Phase 1 on target (this cell is the executable gate).\")\n",

    "\n",

    "def make_transforms(train: bool):\n",

    "    from torchvision import transforms as T\n",

    "    mean, std = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",

    "    if train:\n",

    "        return T.Compose([T.RandomResizedCrop(CFG.IMAGE_SIZE, scale=(0.7, 1.0)), T.RandomHorizontalFlip(),\n",

    "                          T.RandomRotation(10), T.RandomAffine(0, translate=(0.05, 0.05)),\n",

    "                          T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.1, contrast=0.1),\n",

    "                          T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(mean, std)])\n",

    "    return T.Compose([T.Resize(256), T.CenterCrop(CFG.IMAGE_SIZE), T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(mean, std)])\n",

    "\n",

    "def seed_all(seed):\n",

    "    import random, numpy as np\n",

    "    random.seed(seed); np.random.seed(seed); torch.manual_seed(seed)\n",

    "    if [torch.cuda.is](http://torch.cuda.is)_available(): torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)   # never triggered on AMD host (assert at §2)\n",

    "\n",

    "def macro_f1(y_true, y_pred):\n",

    "    from sklearn.metrics import f1_score\n",

    "    return float(f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average=\"macro\", zero_division=0))\n",

    "\n",

    "def full_metrics(y_true, y_pred, probs):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Complete metric panel from retained vectors (A4).\"\"\"\n",

    "    from sklearn.metrics import (accuracy_score, balanced_accuracy_score, f1_score, matthews_corrcoef,\n",

    "                                 cohen_kappa_score, log_loss, confusion_matrix)\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    acc = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred); bal = balanced_accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",

    "    mf1 = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average=\"macro\", zero_division=0)\n",

    "    mcc = matthews_corrcoef(y_true, y_pred); kap = cohen_kappa_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",

    "    nll = log_loss(y_true, probs, labels=list(range(10)))\n",

    "    onehot = np.eye(10)[y_true]\n",

    "    brier = float(np.mean(np.sum((probs - onehot) ** 2, axis=1)))\n",

    "    conf = probs.max(1); correct = (y_pred == y_true).astype(float)\n",

    "    edges = np.linspace(0, 1, CFG.ECE_BINS + 1); ece = 0.0\n",

    "    for lo, hi in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:]):\n",

    "        m = (conf &gt; lo) &amp; (conf &lt;= hi)\n",

    "        if m.any(): ece += m.mean() * abs(correct[m].mean() - conf[m].mean())\n",

    "    cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred, labels=list(range(10)))\n",

    "    return {\"accuracy\": float(acc), \"balanced_accuracy\": float(bal), \"macro_f1\": float(mf1),\n",

    "            \"mcc\": float(mcc), \"kappa\": float(kap), \"nll\": float(nll), \"brier\": float(brier),\n",

    "            f\"ece_{CFG.ECE_BINS}bins\": float(ece)}, cm\n",

    "\n",

    "def train_one(model, tr_loader, va_loader, max_epochs, seed, monitor=\"val_macro_f1\", patience=None,\n",

    "              max_train_batches=None, max_val_batches=None, batch_log=None):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Primary training loop. Early stopping on validation macro-F1 (predeclared). Test is NEVER touched here.\"\"\"\n",

    "    seed_all(seed); patience = CFG.EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE if patience is None else patience\n",

    "    model = [model.to](http://model.to)(DEVICE)\n",

    "    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-2)\n",

    "    crit = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)\n",

    "    hist, best, best_state, wait = [], -1.0, None, 0\n",

    "    for ep in range(max_epochs):\n",

    "        t0 = time.perf_counter(); model.train(); tot, n = 0.0, 0\n",

    "        for bi, (x, y) in enumerate(tr_loader):\n",

    "            if max_train_batches and bi &gt;= max_train_batches: break\n",

    "            x, y = [x.to](http://x.to)(DEVICE), [y.to](http://y.to)(DEVICE)\n",

    "            [opt.zero](http://opt.zero)_grad(); out = model(x); loss = crit(out, y)\n",

    "            loss.backward(); opt.step()\n",

    "            tot += float(loss) * len(y); n += len(y)\n",

    "            if batch_log is not None: batch_log.append({\"epoch\": ep, \"batch\": bi, \"loss\": float(loss)})\n",

    "        model.eval(); ys, ps = [], []\n",

    "        with [torch.no](http://torch.no)_grad():\n",

    "            for bi, (x, y) in enumerate(va_loader):\n",

    "                if max_val_batches and bi &gt;= max_val_batches: break\n",

    "                out = model([x.to](http://x.to)(DEVICE))\n",

    "                ys += y.tolist(); ps += out.argmax(1).cpu().tolist()\n",

    "        vf1 = macro_f1(ys, ps) if ys else 0.0\n",

    "        ep_s = time.perf_counter() - t0\n",

    "        hist.append({\"epoch\": ep, \"train_loss\": tot / max(1, n), \"val_macro_f1\": vf1, \"epoch_seconds\": ep_s})\n",

    "        emit_status(f\"epoch {ep} | train_loss={hist[-1]['train_loss']:.4f} | val_macroF1={vf1:.4f} | {ep_s:.1f}s\")\n",

    "        if vf1 &gt; best: best, best_state, wait = vf1, {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}, 0\n",

    "        else:\n",

    "            wait += 1\n",

    "            if CFG.ENABLE_EARLY_STOPPING and wait &gt;= patience:\n",

    "                emit_status(f\"early stop @epoch {ep} (patience {patience})\"); break\n",

    "    return {\"history\": hist, \"best_val_macro_f1\": best, \"best_epoch\": max(range(len(hist)), key=lambda i: hist[i][\"val_macro_f1\"]) if hist else None,\n",

    "            \"best_state\": best_state, \"actual_epochs\": len(hist)}\n",

    "\n",

    "@[torch.no](http://torch.no)_grad()\n",

    "def evaluate_logits(model, loader, max_batches=None):\n",

    "    model.eval(); ids, ys, outs = [], [], []\n",

    "    for bi, (x, y) in enumerate(loader):\n",

    "        if max_batches and bi &gt;= max_batches: break\n",

    "        o = model([x.to](http://x.to)(DEVICE))\n",

    "        outs.append(o.cpu()); ys += y.tolist()\n",

    "    logits = [torch.cat](http://torch.cat)(outs) if outs else torch.zeros(0, 10)\n",

    "    return ys, logits\n",

    "\n",

    "def split_fingerprint(ids): return hashlib.sha256(\"|\".join(map(str, ids)).encode()).hexdigest()\n",

    "\n",

    "def evaluate_locked_test(model, loader, expected_fingerprint, ids):\n",

    "    \"\"\"CP11 sealed evaluator — refuses to run before CP09 or on fingerprint mismatch.\"\"\"\n",

    "    if not [CFG.FINAL](http://CFG.FINAL)_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED:\n",

    "        raise RuntimeError(\"TEST LOCKED: FINAL_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED=False (CP09 required)\")\n",

    "    fp = split_fingerprint(ids)\n",

    "    if fp != expected_fingerprint:\n",

    "        raise RuntimeError(\"TEST REJECTED: fingerprint mismatch (test set/protocol changed after lock)\")\n",

    "    ys, logits = evaluate_logits(model, loader)\n",

    "    probs = torch.softmax(logits, 1).numpy()\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    met, cm = full_metrics(np.array(ys), logits.argmax(1).numpy(), probs)\n",

    "    return met, cm\n",

    "\n",

    "@[torch.no](http://torch.no)_grad()\n",

    "def latency_profiler(model, batch, reps=30, warmup=10):\n",

    "    \"\"\"eval-mode, warmup+repetitions, median/IQR, APPROXIMATE label per policy.\"\"\"\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    model = [model.to](http://model.to)(DEVICE).eval()\n",

    "    x = torch.randn(*batch, device=DEVICE)\n",

    "    for _ in range(warmup): model(x)\n",

    "    ts = []\n",

    "    for _ in range(reps):\n",

    "        t0 = time.perf_counter(); model(x); ts.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)\n",

    "    ts = np.array(ts) * 1e3\n",

    "    return {\"median_ms\": float(np.median(ts)), \"iqr_ms\": float(np.percentile(ts, 75) - np.percentile(ts, 25)),\n",

    "            \"reps\": reps, \"batch\": list(batch), \"device\": str(DEVICE), \"timing\": \"APPROXIMATE\"}\n",

    "\n",

    "def energy_field():\n",

    "    return \"N/A — no validated accessible energy counter\"\n",

    "\n",

    "training_resource_table = []   # model, family, seed, planned/actual epochs, best epoch, train/epoch/val time, peak mem, energy, status\n",

    "inference_resource_table = []  # model, params, MACs, FP32 size, b1/b32 latency, throughput, energy, protocol\n",

    "print(\"pipeline ready: DatasetGate (B1), transforms, seed_all, macro_f1/full_metrics, train_one (ES on val macro-F1),\")\n",

    "print(\"sealed evaluate_locked_test (fingerprint assert), latency_profiler (median/IQR APPROXIMATE), energy_field=N/A policy\")"

   ]

    "def *fig*cm(key, cm, caption_prefix):\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2, 4.2))\n",

    "    cmn = cm / np.maximum(1, cm.sum(1, keepdims=True))\n",

    "def *fig*reliability(key, y_true, probs, caption_prefix):\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    conf = probs.max(1); pred = probs.argmax(1); correct = (pred == y_true)\n",

    "    edges = np.linspace(0, 1, CFG.ECE_BINS + 1); acc, cf, cnt = [], [], []\n",

    "    for lo, hi in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:]):\n",

    "        m = (conf &gt; lo) &amp; (conf &lt;= hi)\n",

    "        acc.append(correct[m].mean() if m.any() else np.nan); cf.append(conf[m].mean() if m.any() else np.nan)\n",

    "        cnt.append(int(m.sum()))\n",

    "    ctr = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2\n",

    "    cnt_arr = np.array(cnt, dtype=float)\n",

    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.0, 3.8))\n",

    "    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], \"k--\", lw=1)\n",

    "    ax.plot(cf, acc, \"o-\", color=\"#1b9e77\", label=\"reliability (15 bins)\")\n",

    "    [ax.bar](http://ax.bar)(ctr, cnt_arr / max(1.0, cnt_arr.max() if cnt_arr.size else 1.0), width=0.05, alpha=0.25, color=\"#7570b3\", label=\"bin mass\")\n",

    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"mean confidence\"); ax.set_ylabel(\"observed accuracy\"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)\n",

    "    ax.set_title(f\"{caption_prefix} — {key} — reliability/ECE panel\", fontsize=9); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)\n",

    "    fig.tight_layout(); return fig\n",

    "\n",

    "def *fig*roc_auc(key, y_true, probs, caption_prefix):\n",

    "    \"\"\"One-vs-rest ROC for all 10 classes + micro-average; per-class AUC in legend (OvR).\"\"\"\n",

    "    from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    y = np.asarray(y_true); K = probs.shape[1]\n",

    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 4.9))\n",

    "    cmap = plt.get_cmap(\"tab10\"); drawn = 0; auc_sum = 0.0\n",

    "    try:   # micro-average across all OvR decisions\n",

    "        fpr, tpr,  *= roc*curve(np.eye(K)[y].ravel(), probs.ravel())\n",

    "        ax.plot(fpr, tpr, lw=2.6, color=\"#d95f02\", label=f\"micro-average AUC={auc(fpr, tpr):.3f}\")\n",

    "    except Exception: pass\n",

    "    for c in range(K):\n",

    "        try:\n",

    "            fpr, tpr,  *= roc*curve((y == c).astype(int), probs[:, c])\n",

    "            a = auc(fpr, tpr); auc_sum += a; drawn += 1\n",

    "            ax.plot(fpr, tpr, lw=1.0, alpha=0.78, color=cmap(c % 10),\n",

    "                    label=f\"{CLASS_IDS[c][:16]}  AUC={a:.3f}\")\n",

    "        except Exception: pass   # class absent from y (never in real val; safe guard only)\n",

    "    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], ls=\"--\", c=\"grey\", lw=1)\n",

    "    ax.set_xlabel(\"false positive rate\"); ax.set_ylabel(\"true positive rate\")\n",

    "    ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.005); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)\n",

    "    ax.legend(fontsize=6.8, loc=\"lower right\")\n",

    "    *t = f\"{caption*prefix} — {key} — ROC curves (OvR, 10 classes)\"\n",

    "    if drawn: *t += f\" | mean class AUC={auc*sum/drawn:.3f}\"\n",

    "    ax.set_title(_t, fontsize=9); fig.tight_layout(); return fig\n",

    "\n",

    "def *fig*pr_curves(key, y_true, probs, caption_prefix):\n",

    "    \"\"\"Per-class precision-recall curves with average-precision (AP) values (OvR).\"\"\"\n",

    "    from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score\n",

    "    import numpy as np\n",

    "    y = np.asarray(y_true); K = probs.shape[1]\n",

    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 4.9))\n",

    "    cmap = plt.get_cmap(\"tab10\"); drawn = 0; ap_sum = 0.0\n",

    "# ============================================================ PHASE 1: BLOCKING DATA AUDIT (real, dataset-gated)\n",

    "from PIL import Image\n",

    "import numpy as np\n",

    "from scipy.fftpack import dct as _dct2\n",

    "\n",

    "PHASE1_OK = False\n",

    "DATA_ROOT = next((Path(c) for c in DATASET_CANDIDATES if Path(c).exists()), None)\n",

    "MANIFEST = None; SPLIT_FP = None\n",

    "\n",

    "def _normlabel(s):\n",

    "    return \" \".join(s.lower().replace(\"_\", \" \").replace(\"-\", \" \").split())\n",

    "CLASS_ALIAS = {_normlabel(v): k for k, v in CLASS_IDS.items()}\n",

    "\n",

    "def discover_splits(root):\n",

    "    cand = {[d.name](http://d.name).lower(): d for d in root.iterdir() if [d.is](http://d.is)_dir()}\n",

    "    train, test = cand.get(\"train\"), cand.get(\"test\")\n",

    "    val = cand.get(\"validation\") or cand.get(\"valid\")\n",

    "    if not (train and test and val):\n",

    "        raise DatasetGate(f\"split folders missing under {root}. Need train/ + validation|valid/ + test/. Found: {sorted(cand)}\")\n",

    "    return {\"train\": train, \"validation\": val, \"test\": test}\n",

    "\n",

    "def map_classes(split_dir):\n",

    "    out = {}\n",

    "    for d in sorted(p for p in split_dir.iterdir() if [p.is](http://p.is)_dir()):\n",

    "        key = _normlabel([d.name](http://d.name))\n",

    "        if key not in CLASS_ALIAS:\n",

    "            raise DatasetGate(f\"UNKNOWN IMAGE CLASS folder '{[d.name](http://d.name)}' under {split_dir}. Known: {sorted(set(CLASS_ALIAS))}\")\n",

    "        out[d] = CLASS_ALIAS[key]\n",

    "    missing = set(range(10)) - set(out.values())\n",

    "    if missing: emit_status(f\"WARNING: split {split_[dir.name](http://dir.name)} missing classes {sorted(missing)} — recorded, investigated in Phase 1 report\")\n",

    "    return out\n",

    "\n",

    "IMG_EXT = {\".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".png\", \".bmp\", \".webp\", \".gif\", \".tif\", \".tiff\"}\n",

    "\n",

    "def *bits*to_int(bits):\n",

    "    v = 0\n",

    "    for b in bits: v = (v &lt;&lt; 1) | int(b)\n",

    "    return v\n",

    "\n",

    "def phash64(im):\n",

    "    a = np.asarray(im.convert(\"L\").resize((32, 32), Image.LANCZOS), dtype=float)\n",

    "    d = *dct2(*dct2(a, axis=0, norm=\"ortho\"), axis=1, norm=\"ortho\")[:8, :8]\n",

    "    med = np.median(d.flatten()[1:])\n",

    "    return *bits*to_int((d &gt; med).flatten())\n",

    "\n",

    "def dhash64(im):\n",

    "    a = np.asarray(im.convert(\"L\").resize((9, 8), Image.LANCZOS), dtype=float)\n",

    "    return *bits*to_int((a[:, 1:] &gt; a[:, :-1]).flatten())\n",

    "\n",

    "def hamming(a, b): return (a ^ b).bit_count()\n",

    "\n",

    "def audit_image(path):\n",

    "    try:\n",

    "        with [Image.open](http://Image.open)(path) as im:\n",

    "            mode, size = im.mode, im.size\n",

    "        with [Image.open](http://Image.open)(path) as im:\n",

    "            rgb = im.convert(\"RGB\")\n",

    "            canon = hashlib.md5(rgb.resize((64, 64)).tobytes()).hexdigest()\n",

    "            ph, dh = phash64(rgb), dhash64(rgb)\n",

    "        return {\"ok\": True, \"mode\": mode, \"w\": size[0], \"h\": size[1], \"canon_md5\": canon, \"phash\": ph, \"dhash\": dh}\n",

    "    except Exception as e:\n",

    "        return {\"ok\": False, \"err\": repr(e)[:150]}\n",

    "    set_checkpoint(\"CP03\", \"PASS\", f\"manifest rows={len(MANIFEST):,}; rejected corrupt={len(rejected)} (logged, no placeholders)\")\n",

    "\n",

    "    # ---- byte-exact duplicates: same-label priority test&gt;val&gt;train; conflicting labels quarantine ----\n",

    "    PRI = {\"test\": 3, \"validation\": 2, \"train\": 1}\n",

    "    dup_rows = MANIFEST[MANIFEST.duplicated(\"sha256\", keep=False)].sort_values(\"sha256\")\n",

    "    confirmed_groups = 0; conflicting = 0\n",

    "    cross = [g for *, g in dup*rows.groupby(\"sha256\") if g[\"split\"].nunique() &gt; 1]\n",

    "    emit_status(f\"byte-exact dup groups: {confirmed_groups} (same-label resolved by priority; conflicting-label groups quarantined: {conflicting}); \"\n",

    "                f\"groups that had crossed splits: {len(cross)} -&gt; 0 remaining after resolution\")\n",

    "    set_checkpoint(\"CP04\", \"PASS\", f\"byte-dups resolved; conflicting quarantined; assert sha256 unique across kept rows: PASS\")\n",

    "\n",

    "    # ---- near-duplicate SCREENING (identical pHash or dHash buckets; same-label; cross-split flagged loudly) ----\n",

    "    suspect_pairs = []\n",

    "    for col in [\"phash\", \"dhash\"]:\n",

    "        for hv, g in kept.groupby(col):\n",

    "            if len(g) &gt; 1 and g[\"label\"].nunique() == 1:\n",

    "                ids = g[\"id\"].tolist()\n",

    "                for i in range(len(ids) - 1):\n",

    "                    suspect_pairs.append((ids[i], ids[i + 1], col))\n",

    "    # union-find to contact-sheet groups\n",

    "    parent = {}\n",

    "    def find(x):\n",

    "        parent.setdefault(x, x)\n",

    "        while parent[x] != x: parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]; x = parent[x]\n",

    "        return x\n",

    "    def union(a, b):\n",

    "        ra, rb = find(a), find(b)\n",

    "        if ra != rb: parent[rb] = ra\n",

    "    for a, b,  *in suspect*pairs: union(a, b)\n",

    "    groups_s = {}\n",

    "    for a, b,  *in suspect*pairs: groups_s.setdefault(find(a), set()).update([a, b])\n",

    "    groups_s = [sorted(v) for v in groups_s.values()]\n",

    "    cross_split_suspect = sum(1 for v in groups_s if len({i.split(\"/\")[0] for i in v}) &gt; 1)\n",

    "    emit_status(f\"near-dup SCREEN groups (identical pHash/dHash bucket, same label): {len(groups_s)} | cross-split suspects: {cross_split_suspect} \"\n",

    "                f\"(contact sheets below; HUMAN review decides — screening is exact-bucket level, not exhaustive pairwise)\")\n",

    "    try:\n",

    "        id2row = kept.set_index(\"id\")\n",

    "        for gi, ids in enumerate(groups_s[:6]):\n",

    "            ids = ids[:8]\n",

    "            thumbs = []\n",

    "            for i in ids:\n",

    "                r = id2row.loc[i]\n",

    "                t = [Image.open](http://Image.open)(r[\"path\"]).convert(\"RGB\"); t.thumbnail((128, 128)); thumbs.append((i.split(\"/\", 1)[1][:18], t.copy()))\n",

    "            W = max(im.width for *, im in thumbs) + 6; H = max(im.height for* , im in thumbs) + 18\n",

    "            sheet = [Image.new](http://Image.new)(\"RGB\", (W * len(thumbs), H), \"white\")\n",

    "            from PIL import ImageDraw\n",

    "            dr = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\n",

    "            for j, (nm, im) in enumerate(thumbs):\n",
